C056.story: A 2002 Portuguese 20-euro-cent coin, from the first year of the euro. Portugal's side shows the royal seal of 1142, with seven castles and five shields, designed by Vítor Santos. The other side, shared by every euro country, was designed by Luc Luycx. Struck in Nordic gold, a golden copper alloy.
